part.text:
All 1936 symbol-solver tests pass, and the reproduction now resolves both calls.

**Fix:** Added a `TextBlockLiteralExpr` case to `TypeExtractor` in javaparser-symbol-solver-core/src/main/java/com/github/javaparser/symbolsolver/javaparsermodel/TypeExtractor.java:298, returning `stringReferenceType` (i.e., `java.lang.String`) just like `StringLiteralExpr`. Previously the default visitor threw `UnsupportedOperationException: com.github.javaparser.ast.expr.TextBlockLiteralExpr`, which made method resolution fail on any method call whose scope is a text block (e.g. `"""...""".formatted(...)` or `String.format` usage on text blocks).

Verification:
- Reproduction of the issue now prints `java.lang.String.formatted(java.lang.Object...)` for both the single-line and multi-line string cases.
- `mvn -pl javaparser-symbol-solver-testing test`: 1936 tests, 0 failures.
